user.title: Continuous Conversation
user.description: Routes automations through this agent using a reversible runtime Assist Pipeline patch. Tested on Core 2026.9.3 / 2026.11.2; see README for upgrade compatibility.

data_description.termination_rules: Add one rule per phrase. Leave the response empty or enable End silently to stop without speech. Rules override the shared list; duplicate normalized phrases are not allowed.
data_description.termination_response: Used for shared-list phrases without a per-phrase rule.
data_description.repair_repeated_mode_prefix: Example: “chế độ chế độ tiếp khách” → “chế độ tiếp khách”. Only collapse this repeated leading prefix when a target follows.

error.invalid_text: The shared response must contain text. Rule phrases must contain text and be unique after normalization.
